correctness.rationale: For any abelian group of odd order \(n\ge5\), the group table has no intercalates, so the published all-field theorem gives \(H_1\)=H_i(i>=3)=0 and \(H_2\) dimension \((n-1)^3\). The group acts simplicially. A nonidentity translation has odd orbit length at least 3; an invariant clique therefore lies entirely in one preserved line of the row, column, or sum class, or cannot exist. Each invariant full simplex contributes signed Lefschetz trace 1, yielding exact character values. Equality with the triple augmentation character and the explicit Fourier multiplicities follow by semisimplicity. Test code enumerates exact faces, signed traces, and mod-two boundary ranks in four examples, without substituting tests for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural \(A\times A\) action is a mathematically meaningful invariant invisible to known Betti ranks and ordinary wedge homotopy. The result classifies the entire rational module for every cyclic and noncyclic finite abelian group of odd order at least five, including all character multiplicities and n-1 fixed homology classes. Oddness is motivated by both absence of intercalates and nonidentity orbit length at least three; this is more than numerical rank recomputation.
